INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_TEST_SELECT_SRC
(
                CIFMERGEID
                ,BANK_ID
                ,PRIMARYCIF
                ,CASEID
                ,CIFID
                ,ISPRIMARY
                ,ENTITYTYPE
                ,RETORCORP
                ,STATUS
                ,OWNERUSERID
                ,ASSIGNEDUSERID
                ,CREATEDUSERID
                ,ASSIGNEDGROUPID
                ,BODATECREATED
                ,BOCREATEDBY
                ,BODATEMODIFIED
                ,BOMODIFIEDBY
                ,CONCURDETECT_X
                ,XMLDATA
                ,BOACLID
                ,EXTENSIONID
                ,SECURITYILHINT
                ,SECURITYIUHINT
                ,SECURITYGLHINT
                ,SECURITYGUHINT
                ,DATEOFINTIATIONOFMERGE
                ,CREATEDFROMFLAG
                ,DATEOFAPPROVAL
                ,REASONREMARKS
                ,ISREJECTED
                ,PRIMARYID
                ,MERGEREASON
                ,MERGEREASONREMARKS
                ,DATEOFMERGECOMPLETION
                ,PERSONLASTNAME
                ,TMDATE
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                 CC.CIFMERGEID
                ,CC.BANK_ID
                ,CC.PRIMARYCIF
                ,CC.CASEID
                ,CC.CIFID
                ,CC.ISPRIMARY
                ,CC.ENTITYTYPE
                ,CC.RETORCORP
                ,CC.STATUS
                ,CC.OWNERUSERID
                ,CC.ASSIGNEDUSERID
                ,CC.CREATEDUSERID
                ,CC.ASSIGNEDGROUPID
                ,CC.BODATECREATED
                ,CC.BOCREATEDBY
                ,CC.BODATEMODIFIED
                ,CC.BOMODIFIEDBY
                ,CC.CONCURDETECT_X
                ,CC.XMLDATA
                ,CC.BOACLID
                ,CC.EXTENSIONID
                ,CC.SECURITYILHINT
                ,CC.SECURITYIUHINT
                ,CC.SECURITYGLHINT
                ,CC.SECURITYGUHINT
                ,CC.DATEOFINTIATIONOFMERGE
                ,CC.CREATEDFROMFLAG
                ,CC.DATEOFAPPROVAL
                ,CC.REASONREMARKS
                ,CC.ISREJECTED
                ,CC.PRIMARYID
                ,CC.MERGEREASON
                ,CC.MERGEREASONREMARKS
                ,CC.DATEOFMERGECOMPLETION
                ,CC.PERSONLASTNAME
                ,CC.TMDATE
                ,CC.FILE_NAME
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.CRM_TEST CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_TEST B
            ON CC.CIFMERGEID  = B.CIFMERGEID 
            AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME, 5) = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_TEST_GROUP_SRC
(
                CIFMERGEID

                ,CASEID
                ,CIFID

select 
                CIFMERGEID
                ,BANK_ID
                ,PRIMARYCIF
                ,CASEID
                ,CIFID
                ,ISPRIMARY
                ,ENTITYTYPE
                ,RETORCORP
                ,STATUS
                ,OWNERUSERID
                ,ASSIGNEDUSERID
                ,CREATEDUSERID
                ,ASSIGNEDGROUPID
                ,BODATECREATED
                ,BOCREATEDBY
                ,BODATEMODIFIED
                ,BOMODIFIEDBY
                ,CONCURDETECT_X
                ,XMLDATA
                ,BOACLID
                ,EXTENSIONID
                ,SECURITYILHINT
                ,SECURITYIUHINT
                ,SECURITYGLHINT
                ,SECURITYGUHINT
                ,DATEOFINTIATIONOFMERGE
                ,CREATEDFROMFLAG
                ,DATEOFAPPROVAL
                ,REASONREMARKS
                ,ISREJECTED
                ,PRIMARYID
                ,MERGEREASON
                ,MERGEREASONREMARKS
                ,DATEOFMERGECOMPLETION
                ,PERSONLASTNAME
                ,TMDATE
				,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                CIFMERGEID
                ,BANK_ID
                ,PRIMARYCIF
                ,CASEID
                ,CIFID
                ,ISPRIMARY
                ,ENTITYTYPE
                ,RETORCORP
                ,STATUS
                ,OWNERUSERID
                ,ASSIGNEDUSERID
                ,CREATEDUSERID
                ,ASSIGNEDGROUPID
                ,BODATECREATED
                ,BOCREATEDBY
                ,BODATEMODIFIED
                ,BOMODIFIEDBY
                ,CONCURDETECT_X
                ,XMLDATA
                ,BOACLID
                ,EXTENSIONID
                ,SECURITYILHINT
                ,SECURITYIUHINT
                ,SECURITYGLHINT
                ,SECURITYGUHINT
                ,DATEOFINTIATIONOFMERGE
                ,CREATEDFROMFLAG
                ,DATEOFAPPROVAL
                ,REASONREMARKS
                ,ISREJECTED
                ,PRIMARYID
                ,MERGEREASON
                ,MERGEREASONREMARKS
                ,DATEOFMERGECOMPLETION
                ,PERSONLASTNAME
                ,TMDATE
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_TEST_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                CIFMERGEID
                ,BANK_ID
                ,PRIMARYCIF
                ,CASEID
                ,CIFID
                ,ISPRIMARY
                ,ENTITYTYPE
                ,RETORCORP
                ,STATUS
                ,OWNERUSERID
                ,ASSIGNEDUSERID
                ,CREATEDUSERID
                ,ASSIGNEDGROUPID
                ,BODATECREATED
                ,BOCREATEDBY
                ,BODATEMODIFIED
                ,BOMODIFIEDBY
                ,CONCURDETECT_X
                ,XMLDATA
                ,BOACLID
                ,EXTENSIONID
                ,SECURITYILHINT
                ,SECURITYIUHINT
                ,SECURITYGLHINT
                ,SECURITYGUHINT
                ,DATEOFINTIATIONOFMERGE
                ,CREATEDFROMFLAG
                ,DATEOFAPPROVAL
                ,REASONREMARKS
                ,ISREJECTED
                ,PRIMARYID
                ,MERGEREASON
                ,MERGEREASONREMARKS
                ,DATEOFMERGECOMPLETION
                ,PERSONLASTNAME
                ,TMDATE
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = dateadd(dd,-1,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE))  FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_TEST];


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_TEST A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_TEST_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.CIFMERGEID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CIFMERGEID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(LEFT(A.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
